name: ClauseCopilot
description: 📄 Analyze vendor contracts effortlessly with ClauseCopilot, providing risk assessments, summaries, and negotiation language for informed decisions.

paragraphs: ClauseCopilot is a user-friendly application designed to help you manage vendor risk and streamline contract analysis. This tool summarizes contracts, highlights risky clauses with evidence, drafts negotiation emails, and allows easy searching through clauses. With ClauseCopilot, you gain clarity and confidence in your contracts, making your negotiations smoother and more informed.
features: Contract Summarization: Quickly understand the main points of any contract without having to read every line.
Risk Flagging: Instantly identify risky clauses with supporting evidence, so you can make better decisions.
Email Drafting: Save time by generating negotiation emails with suggested language tailored to your needs.
Clause Search: Easily search for specific clauses within contracts for quick reference.
